items.q: And there was another boy name of Cuban Bennett. He played that beautiful horn but he had control, and those progressions he was making, they were something else.

ctx.x: always loved that beauty. MR. BUTLER: Oh, yes, and I. And then Doc Cheatham And there was another boy name of Cuban Bennett. He played that beautiful horn but he had control, and those progressions he was making, they were something else. And they had another fellow around and was playing fast, just as fast as this one, playing as much horn as anyone, his name was Jabbo Smith. And he and Louis Armstrong, told me, had a battle. And one didn't know who was winning, only Louis Armstrong had that particular delivery.…
And I was trying to get all these in together. That's what was creating -- I was becoming Jack Butler.
